_comment: FIX-Task-63 — migration NUMBER RESERVATIONS. A migration filename is an ORDER KEY (BP-99), so two files sharing a number prefix have an undefined apply order. That happened for real on 2026-09-18: two parallel sessions wrote 20260918000010_* and 20260918000011_* into the same working tree, and one task had to be moved into a reserved block mid-flight. Before creating a migration file, claim its prefix here (node scripts/migrations/reserve-number.mjs --next). `migration-gate.mjs --static` (check S4) fails if two owners claim one prefix, or if a file appears under a prefix a different owner reserved.

reservations.reason: Reserved block, deliberately far from the concurrent payout workstream's 20260918000010-13 range. The +50000 offset is the convention for 'next free block when the natural number is contested'.
Second file of the same reserved block (anon policy alignment).
